faq.a: A signature, a stamp or a small passport-style crop usually is. A large detailed photo becomes very small and soft at 10 KB, so for photos try 20 KB or 50 KB instead.

faq.q: Can I use it for a signature?
faq.a: Yes. Scan or photograph the signature on white paper, crop closely around it, then add it here. Small black-on-white images compress very well.
